Class EmpiricalEngineBenchmarkRunner

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.benchmark.EmpiricalEngineBenchmarkRunner
public class EmpiricalEngineBenchmarkRunner extends Object

Empirical Multi-Engine invalid input: '&' Multi-Resolution Benchmark Suite

Performs rigorous, non-simulated real-time empirical benchmarking of Ether simulation engines across all canonical H3 hexagonal grid resolutions (Res 2: 5,882 cells, Res 3: 41,162 cells, Res 4: 288,122 cells), comparing:

  • Pure CPU Java JIT (Monocœur): Reference sequential object model execution
  • Java 21 Vector SIMD invalid input: '&' Multi-Threading (Multicœur): Parallelized contiguous memory vector processing
  • Native Rust Core (AVX-512 + Rayon): Zero-copy FFI execution via ether_core_native
Computes exact throughput (TPS), single-cell kernel latency (ns/cell/tick), memory pressure, and generates markdown reports conforming to docs/EMPIRICAL_ENGINE_VALIDATION_AND_BENCHMARKING.md.
